name: Why is final detail work important for a construction project?

mainEntity.name: Why is final detail work important for a construction project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Final detail work is crucial because it ensures the project's overall quality, functionality, and aesthetic appeal. It addresses any minor deficiencies that might detract from the finished product, contributes to client satisfaction, and confirms that the project meets all specifications and safety standards. Neglecting this phase can lead to a less polished result and potential issues down the line.
acceptedAnswer.description: Final detail work is important for ensuring overall quality, functionality, and aesthetic appeal, and for client satisfaction.
